parrafo.es: Barbería en Johnson Street, Hollywood, con un equipo de cinco barberos independientes. Fades, arreglo de barba, diseños a mano alzada y cortes de niños, cada uno con su propio sello y el mismo nivel de detalle.
parrafo.en: Barbershop on Johnson Street in Hollywood, with a team of five independent barbers under one roof. Fades, beard grooming, freehand designs and kids cuts, each barber with their own signature and the same level of detail.

parrafo_1.es: Refined Cuts Barbershop abrió sus puertas en 2022 en Johnson Street, Hollywood. Cada silla la ocupa un barbero independiente con su propia especialidad, del fade clásico al diseño a mano alzada, unidos bajo el mismo techo y el mismo estándar de limpieza y detalle.
parrafo_1.en: Refined Cuts Barbershop opened its doors in 2022 on Johnson Street in Hollywood. Every chair is run by an independent barber with their own specialty, from the classic fade to freehand design work, all under one roof and the same standard of cleanliness and detail.

parrafo_2.es: El trabajo habla por el equipo: 5.0 estrellas en Booksy con 582 reseñas repartidas entre los cinco barberos, cada una de un cliente confirmado que reservó su cita en línea.
parrafo_2.en: The work speaks for the team: 5.0 stars on Booksy with 582 reviews spread across the five barbers, each one from a confirmed client who booked their appointment online.

texto.es: Reserva en Booksy con el barbero que prefieras, o escríbenos por Instagram si es tu primera vez y quieres una recomendación.
texto.en: Book on Booksy with the barber you prefer, or message us on Instagram if it is your first visit and you want a recommendation.

texto.es: Fade, diseño, arreglo de barba o corte clásico: platicamos el resultado que buscas antes de encender la máquina.
texto.en: Fade, freehand design, beard work or a classic cut: we talk through the look you want before the clippers come out.

texto.es: Precisión en cada línea, con el mismo cuidado sin importar qué silla ocupes ni qué barbero te atienda.
texto.en: Precision in every line, with the same care no matter which chair or which barber you sit with.

texto.es: Repasamos el acabado contigo antes de que te levantes de la silla. Ese detalle es el que nos ganó el 5.0 en Booksy.
texto.en: We go over the finish with you before you get up from the chair. That detail is what earned us the 5.0 on Booksy.

nota.es: Cada barbero de Refined Cuts fija su propio precio en Booksy. Los precios de abajo son el punto de partida del equipo; confirma el valor exacto al elegir tu barbero.
nota.en: Each barber at Refined Cuts sets their own price on Booksy. The prices below are the team's starting point; confirm the exact price when you pick your barber.

texto.es: Fade, tijera o un blend a tu gusto, tallado a tu forma de cara y tu estilo personal.
texto.en: Fade, scissor work or a custom blend, tailored to your face shape and personal style.

texto.es: Tu corte de siempre más un arreglo de barba con líneas limpias y acabado parejo.
texto.en: Your regular cut plus a beard shape-up with clean lines and an even finish.

texto.es: Paciencia y buena mano con los más chicos, del primer corte en adelante.
texto.en: Patience and a steady hand with the little ones, from their very first haircut on.

texto.es: Diseños a mano alzada y paquetes completos con toalla caliente, tratamiento facial y más.
texto.en: Freehand designs and full packages with hot towel treatment, facial care and more.

pie.es: ¿No sabes qué barbero elegir? Escríbenos por Instagram y te ayudamos antes de tu cita.
pie.en: Not sure which barber to pick? Message us on Instagram and we will help before your visit.

items.quote: Walter is a good man. And the rest of the crew are polite and respectful. As a man in my sixties it's hard to find a shop that is both professional, clean and welcoming. Walter has been my stylist for over 3 years. I highly recommend Walter and Refine cuts.

I had a great experience with my two year old son haircut, today! It turned out exactly how I wanted it to. Khaleel was really patient and made the experience as comfortable as possible for a toddler. We'll definitely be back and I highly recommend!
Kiko does a great job on my cut, he is very professional and friendly he makes you feel at home. Highly would recommend booking with him.
